articles.title: Djokovic Loses in Shanghai Just Days After a Big Win
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic lost to Hubert Hurkacz for the first time ever at the Shanghai Masters, three days after winning the China Open.

articles.title: BTS Star RM Shows His Art Collection at a Museum
articles.summary: BTS leader RM is showing his art collection at a San Francisco museum, and fans are crowding in, some visiting an art museum for the first time.

articles.title: Zoo Lions Act More Like Wild Lions With Big Meals
articles.summary: An Australian study found zoo lions given occasional whole-animal meals ate, rested and moved more like lions in the wild.
